issues: No public course catalog/program of studies found. The School Counseling site (Google Sites, cvsu.org domain) requires sign-in, so a course guide may exist there but cannot be verified - could be no_public_catalog. Teacher pages under Academics list some course names only. Student handbook is 2025-26 (no 2026-27 version linked) and contains graduation requirements (English 4, Science 3, Math 3, Global Studies 3, Fine Arts 1, Health 0.5, PE 1.5, Electives 5.5 + PBGRs). schools.csv-era domain cvsuvt.org (and guesses painemountain.org / pmsdvt.org) are unreachable; live domain is cvsu.org. A search hit for a '2026~27' Highlander course site (sites.google.com/wmtps.org) is NOT this school (different domain, sign-in only).
